subject: RICLPM using lavaan - fixing measurement error is not possible

messages.author: 8b7c2fbd21807814
messages.subject: RICLPM using lavaan - fixing measurement error is not possible
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to fit a random intercept cross-lagged panel model using Lavaan. If I use the example code provided by Jeroen Mulder (https://jeroendmulder.github.io/RI-CLPM/lavaan.html) it works. However, I would like to fix the measurement error of the observed variables that I use as single indicators to avoid assuming perfect measurement. 

If I run the model with this code, it works: 
RICLPM_1<- '
  # Create between components (random intercepts)
  RIx =~ 1*Grief_1 + 1*Grief_2 + 1*Grief_3 + 1*Grief_4 + 1*Grief_5 + 1*Grief_6 + 1*Grief_7 + 1*Grief_8 + 1*Grief_9 + 1*Grief_10 + 1*Grief_11
  RIy =~ 1*Dep_1 + 1*Dep_2 + 1*Dep_3 + 1*Dep_4 + 1*Dep_5 + 1*Dep_6 + 1*Dep_7 + 1*Dep_8 + 1*Dep_9 + 1*Dep_10 + 1*Dep_11

RICLPM1.fit <- lavaan(RICLPM_1,
                      data = df_small,
                      missing = 'ML',

                      int.ov.free = T
)

fit_model1 <- summary(RICLPM1.fit, standardized = T, fit.measure = TRUE)
fit_model1
